question.text: The perpendicular distance from the origin to the plane containing the two lines, <math><mfrac><mrow><mi>x</mi><mi> </mi><mo>+</mo><mi> </mi><mn>2</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>y</mi><mi> </mi><mo>-</mo><mi> </mi><mn>2</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>z</mi><mi> </mi><mo>+</mo><mi> </mi><mn>5</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>7</mn></mrow></mfrac></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><mi>x</mi><mi> </mi><mo>-</mo><mi> </mi><mn>1</mn></mrow><mn>1</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>y</mi><mi> </mi><mo>-</mo><mi> </mi><mn>4</mn></mrow><mn>4</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>z</mi><mi> </mi><mo>+</mo><mi> </mi><mn>4</mn></mrow><mn>7</mn></mfrac></math>, is

solution.text:
Direction vector of normal to the plane =i^j^k^357147=7i^-14j^+7k^

Hence, direction ratio of normal to the plane =<1, -2, 1>

Thus, equation of plane is x-2y+z+11=0

Hence, perpendicular distance from origin =1112+-22+12=116
